::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
India is Marvell's second-largest R&D hub globally. In July 2026, Marvell announced a $250 million investment to double its India workforce and expand Bengaluru and Hyderabad campuses. Teams work on 2nm-and-beyond process nodes. On 2026-07-29 Marvell announced a $250 million, three-year India investment to double its India workforce and add a new wing in Bengaluru and expand Hyderabad.
:::

## What does this firm design?

Custom data centre ASICs, 5G baseband processors, networking switches, storage controllers, and high-speed analog IP. Hyderabad focuses on security solutions; Pune on embedded development for networking and storage.

**Why these scores**

- **Domain difficulty 5/5:** Custom data-centre ASICs, high-speed SerDes/analog IP at leading-edge nodes.
- **Strategic depth 5/5:** India is Marvell's second-largest R&D organisation; teams work on custom AI/cloud silicon.
- **Design completeness 5/5:** Full-chip custom ASIC, networking and storage design work across three Indian sites.
- **India scale 2/5:** Lowered 3->2: Reuters reported a 1,700-strong India workforce in Nov 2025, below ~2k; may rise as hiring doubles.
